angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 462,641 km at 27.51 pc = 0.22 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 36.3525 +/- 0.0161 mas (same row, RUWE 1.09): 27.51 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.665 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Hawthorn et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-836 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.520.3649H/abstract): 462,641 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.678 +/- 0.049 solar masses from Hawthorn et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-836 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.520.3649H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4552 +/- 154 K from Hawthorn et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-836 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.520.3649H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hawthorn et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-836 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.520.3649H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-836.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.624, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-836 (pscomppars): spectral type K V, from Hawthorn et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.520.3649H/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CD-23 12010: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-836 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.284 dex, from Hawthorn et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.520.3649H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-836 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.85276, from Giacalone et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...24G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-836 (pscomppars): age 5.4 Gyr, from Hawthorn et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.520.3649H/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-836 (pscomppars): rotation period 21.987 d, from Hawthorn et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.520.3649H/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-836 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.86 km/s, from Hawthorn et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.520.3649H/abstract)
